αἰνότατον: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; superl. αἰνότατος, masc. acc. sg.: ’most dread’
αἰνῇ: αἰνός — dread, grim, terrible; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ᾷ)
αἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj., epic/dialectal by-form αἰ (used before κε)
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτούς: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. pl.: ’them’ · also intensive, ’the very men themselves’ (with a following τε … τε) · also ’ourselves’, first person, coordinate with another object (νῆάς τε καὶ αὐτούς ’both the ships and ourselves’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast)
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
βάλλων: βάλλω — throw, cast; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’casting’
βίηφιν: βίη — force, might, violence; instrumental case in -φι(ν) (= dat. βίῃ): ’by force’
βουλῇ: βουλή — plan, counsel, council; fem. dat. sg. (ἐνὶ βουλῇ ’in council’)
βοὸς: βοῦς — ox, cow, heifer; gen. sg.
βοῶν: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; gen. pl.
βόες: βοῦς — ox, cow; pl. ’cattle’; masc./fem. nom. pl.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γαῖα: γαῖα — earth, land; fem. nom. sg. (epic = Attic γῆ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γλαφυρῆς: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed; fem. gen. sg.
γλαφυρῷ: γλαφυρός — hollow, hollowed out; masc./neut. dat. sg.
δέος: δέος — fear; also, of the thing feared, danger; neut. nom./acc. sg.
δείσαντες: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having feared’
δεινὸν: δεινός — dread, terrible, awesome; masc. acc. sg. (δεινὸν χόλον ’dread anger’) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (κῦμα): ’dread’; can also be taken adverbially · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’terribly’ (δεινὸν λελακυῖα ’yelping terribly’)
δεισάντων: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. part. act. masc./neut. gen. pl. (same form in Attic): ’of those who feared’
δεσμοῖσι: δεσμός — bond, fetter; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
δηιοτῆτι: δηιοτής — hostile fighting, battle, slaughter; fem. dat. sg.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: διὰ … τινάξῃ = διατινάξῃ ’shake apart, shatter’ · also + acc., causal, ’through, thanks to, by the aid of’ (διὰ … Ἀθήνην) · also as adverb/preverb in tmesis with κοσμηθέντες (διὰ … κοσμηθέντες = διακοσμηθέντες ’drawn up in divisions’) · also + gen., ’through, among’ (διὰ μήλων ’among the flocks’)
δοῦπον: δοῦπος — thud, booming sound; masc. acc. sg.
δοῦρε: δόρυ — spear, shaft; acc. dual, epic stem δουρ-: ’two spears’
δόλον: δόλος — trick, snare, cunning device; masc. acc. sg.
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of goddesses and heroes
εἰμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν): ’we are’
εἰνὶ: ἐν (epic εἰνί, ἐνί) — in, at, on; prep. + dat.
εἰρεσίης: εἰρεσία — rowing; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἴδατα: εἶδαρ — food, dish; neut. acc. pl. εἴδατα: ’dishes’
εἴπω: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. subj. 1 sg.
εὐρύλοχος: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
εὐρύλοχός: Εὐρύλοχος — Eurylochus, a companion of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg., accented before τε
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’) · also possessive genitive with a noun: ’of the god’ (θεοῦ δαῖτα) · also gen. with ἄρχομαι, ’from the god’ (the point of departure) · also masc. gen. sg. used of a goddess (the masc. form serves either sex): θεοῦ εὐνήν ’a goddess’s bed’
θηβαίου: Θηβαῖος — Theban, of Thebes; adj., masc. gen. sg.
θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύραζε: θύραζε — to the outside, out of doors; adv., directional suffix -δε (= -ζε after a vowel)
θύρῃσι: θύρη — door; dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic θύραις; Ionic η for α)
κάλλιμον: κάλλιμος — beautiful, fair (= Attic καλός); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with χρόα
κέ: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); accented before an enclitic · also + subj. in a purpose clause after ὄφρα: ’so that’ (ὄφρα κέ τοι λύσῃ ’so that she may free’)
κέκλυτέ: κλύω — hear, listen to; reduplicated aor. imper. 2 pl., + gen.: ’hear (me)’
κίρκης: Κίρκη — Circe, the enchantress goddess; fem. gen. sg.
κακά: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. pl., substantive: ’evils, troubles’ (πάθομεν κακά ’we suffered troubles’)
κακόν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. acc. sg.: ’a bad thing, evil’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal passive (κακόν τ’ ἀγαθόν τε τέτυκται ’whatever, good or bad, has come to pass’) · also neut. nom. sg. adjective agreeing with πέλωρ: ’evil’ (πέλωρ κακόν ’an evil monster’) · also neut. nom. sg. noun, predicate: ’an evil’ (ἀθάνατον κακόν ’an immortal evil’)
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’) · also neut. acc. sg., attributive with ἦμαρ: ’evil’ (κακὸν ἦμαρ ’the evil day’) · also masc. acc. sg., predicative: ’base, cowardly’ (κακὸν καὶ ἀνήνορα ’base and unmanned’) · also neut. acc. sg. attributive with πῆμα: ’evil’ (πῆμα κακὸν ’evil harm’) · also neut. nom. sg., predicate with an infinitive as subject: κακὸν … βάζειν ’(it is) bad to speak’
κακῶν: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. pl.: ’of ills, of misfortunes’
καλαὶ: καλός — beautiful, fair; fem. nom. pl.
καλεῦντες: καλέω — call, summon; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic by-form of καλέοντες (= Attic καλοῦντες)
κατεκλάσθη: κατακλάω — break down, shatter; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was broken down’ (of the heart)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’) · also + gen., ’all over, throughout’ (κατὰ σπείους κέχυτο ’lay spread all over the cave’) · also + acc., of the part grasped: ’by’ (κατὰ νῶτα λαβών ’taking him by the back’) · also + acc., ’on account of, on the business of’ (κατὰ χρέος ’on business’) · also + gen., ’down in, within’ (κατὰ σπείους κοίλοιο δέδυκεν ’is sunk in the hollow cave’)
κεῖνο: κεῖνος — that; demonstrative pron., neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ἐκεῖνο)
κεῖσ: κεῖσε — thither, to that place; adv., elided (κεῖσ’ = κεῖσε)
κλυτὰ: κλυτός — famous, renowned; neut. nom./acc. pl.
κρατερῆφι: κρατερός — strong, mighty; fem. dat. sg. with epic -φι (= Attic κρατερᾷ), instrumental, with βίηφι
κυανέη: κυάνεος — dark blue, dark; adj., fem. nom. sg., epic -έη (= Attic -έα)
κῆρ: κῆρ — heart; neut. acc. sg., accusative of respect (φίλον κῆρ ’in his own heart’) · also neut. nom. sg., subject of a verb: κῆρ ἤθελε ’my heart wished’
κῦμα: κῦμα — wave; nom. sg. · also acc. sg. (identical neut. form), object of a preposition (κατὰ κῦμα ’over the wave’) · also acc. sg., direct object: μέγα κῦμα ’a great wave’
λαβὼν: λαμβάνω — take, take hold of; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having taken’ (γούνων λαβών ’clasping the knees’, gen. of the part grasped)
λῦσαί: λύω — loose, release, let go; aor. inf. act., used as an imperative: ’release!, let go!’ · also complementary inf. after κελεύω: ’to release’ (ἑτάρους λῦσαί τε κελεύῃς ’bid your companions release you’)
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μάντηος: μάντις — seer, prophet; masc. gen. sg., epic -ηος (= Attic μάντεως)
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’) · also standing for a noun left out: ’a black (ewe)’ (θῆλύν τε μέλαιναν)
μή: μή — not; negative particle (used with imperatives and subjunctives, unlike οὐ) · also introducing a negative purpose/fear clause with the optative in secondary sequence: μή ἑ λάθοι ’lest he should escape notice’ · also μή + fut. inf. after a verb of swearing/promising, negating its content: μή ... βουλευσέμεν ’that ... will not plan’ · also ’lest’ with the subj. after a primary verb (μή πώς ... χαλεπήνῃ ’lest he be harsh’) · also in a question expecting the answer ’no’, after ἦ: ἦ μή … φάσθ’ ἔμμεναι; ’surely you do not say … are?’ · also ’lest’ + subj. after a past verb of urging (κελόμην … μή … λάθηται ’I urged … lest he forget’) · also in a condition, ’if … not’ (εἰ … μή τίς σε βιάζεται) · also with an infinitive used as an imperative, a prohibition: μή μ’ … καταλείπειν ’do not leave me’ · also negating a purpose clause after ἵνα: ’so that … not’ (ἵνα μή τι … ἀλγήσετε ’so that you may not suffer’)
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat. · also + acc., ’after, behind’ (μεθ’ ἡμιόνους ’behind the mules’)
μειλιχίοις: μειλίχιος — gentle, soothing; masc. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσιν
μελαίνῃ: μέλας — black; standing epithet of ships; fem. dat. sg. μέλαινα · also modifying a different noun, not a ship (μελαίνῃ φρικί ’with a dark ripple’, of the sea’s surface)
μετηύδων: μεταυδάω — speak among, address (+ dat.); impf. 1 sg., augment contracted (μετ-ηύδων)
μευ: ἐγώ — I; encl. gen. sg., epic μευ (= Attic μου): ’of me’, with κλύω ’hear me’ · also gen. with ἄγχι: ’near me’ (μευ ἄγχι στᾶσα) · also gen. of possession, ’my’ (οἵ μευ … κῆρ ’my heart’)
μεῖζον: μείζων — greater, larger; neut. nom./acc. sg., comparative of μέγας
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μύθῳ: μῦθος — word, speech, plea; masc. dat. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μᾶλλόν: μάλα — very; comparative adv. μᾶλλον ’more, rather’, accented μᾶλλόν before the enclitic τε: ’all the harder’
μῆλ: μῆλον — sheep or goat, flock-animal; neut. acc. pl. (elided μῆλ’)
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νηῦς: ναῦς — ship; nom. sg., epic νηῦς
νόῳ: νόος — mind, thought; masc. dat. sg., instrumental: ’in mind, in thought’
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἰῶν: ὄϊς (Attic οἶς) — sheep; masc./fem. gen. pl., contracted (= epic ὀίων)
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’) · also article-like with a numeral and noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’the’ (οἱ δὲ δύω σκόπελοι ’the two crags’)
οἳ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (= οἱ, accented οἵ in this position) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; masc. nom. pl. ’they’, demonstrative: οἵ γ’ ὑβρισταί ’are they violent?’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐκέτ: οὐκέτι — no longer; adv., elided (οὐκέτ’ = οὐκέτι)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάντῃ: πάντῃ — everywhere, in every direction; adv.
πάσχοντες: πάσχω — suffer, experience; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
πέτρας: πέτρα — rock, crag, cliff; fem. acc. pl.
πέτρη: πέτρη — rock, crag; fem. nom. sg.
πίεζον: πιέζω — press, squeeze; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐπίεζον): ’I pressed’
πίθοντο: πείθομαι — obey, be persuaded, + dat.; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐπίθοντο)
παρασταδὸν: παρασταδόν — standing beside, at one’s side; adv. (from παρίστημι)
παρὲξ: παρέξ — beside, past, beyond; adv./prep. + acc., here adverbial with εἴποιμι: ’say otherwise, speak beside the point’ · also adv. with ἐλάσωσιν, ’past, beyond’ (τάς γε παρὲξ ἐλάσωσιν ’drive past them’)
περ: περ — even, though; concessive particle, esp. with a participle (= Attic καίπερ) · also used to intensify an adverb or pronoun rather than concede a point: ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’ · also after εἰ, ’if indeed, even if’: εἴ περ γάρ κεν ’if indeed ever’
περιμήδης: Περιμήδης — Perimedes, a companion of Odysseus; masc. nom. sg.
περιμήκεϊ: περιμήκης — very long; fem. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περιμήκει)
ποθι: ποθι — somehow, somewhere; epic enclitic adv. (= Attic πού)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’ · also neut. nom. pl., plain attributive adj. agreeing with a neut. pl. noun (πολλὰ ... δάκρυα ’many tears’) · also neut. acc. pl., plain attributive adj. (κτήματα πολλὰ ’many possessions’) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’again and again’ (πολλὰ περιτροπέοντες) · also neut. nom. pl. as substantive, subject: οἷά τε πολλὰ γίγνεται ’as many things happen’
πολλῷ: πολύς — much, great, many; masc./neut. dat. sg.
προπεσόντες: προπίπτω — fall forward; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’throwing themselves forward’
προτὶ: πρός (epic by-form προτί) — towards, to; prep. + acc.
πρὸς: πρός — towards, against, to; prep. + acc. · also a plain adverb, no case governed: ’besides, in addition’ · also + dat.: πρὸς ἀλλήλῃσιν ἔχονται ’cling close to one another’ · also + gen., ’from, under the protection of’ (πρὸς Διός εἰσιν ’are from Zeus’) · also + dat., ’against’ (ῥαίοιτο πρὸς οὔδεϊ ’be dashed against the floor’) · also + dat., ’in addition to’ (πρὸς τοῖσί τε ὕπνος ’and sleep in addition to these’)
πρῶτα: πρῶτος — first; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first’
πόδας: πούς — foot; acc. pl., accusative of respect
πόλλ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl., elided (πόλλ’ = πολλά): ’many’ · also used adverbially: ‘much, often’ (πόλλ’ ἐπέεσσιν ‘again and again with words’)
πόντον: πόντος — sea, open sea; acc. sg.
πόντῳ: πόντος — sea, open sea; dat. sg.
πώ: πώ — yet, up to now; enclitic adv. (usually with a negative)
πώς: πώς (= enclitic πως) — somehow, in any way; accented πώς because followed by a further enclitic (με): ’lest he somehow...’
πῃ: πῃ — in some way, anywhere; enclitic adv.
σκύλλη: Σκύλλη — Scylla, the sea monster; fem. nom. sg., Ionic/epic (= Attic Σκύλλα)
σοὶ: σύ — you (sg.); dat. sg.: ’to, for you’
σπῆι: σπέος — cave; neut. dat. sg., epic σπῆϊ (contracted σπῆι)
σφέας: σφεῖς — they; pron., masc. acc. pl., epic σφέας (= Attic σφᾶς), governed by διά: ’through them’ · also acc. pl. object of a verb of teaching: ’them’ (σφέας … ἐδίδαξε ’taught them’)
σφιν: σφεῖς — they; epic encl. dat. pl./sg. pron.: ’to/for them’
σὺ: σύ — you (sg.); nom. sg. (grave, mid-clause form)
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’) · also in ἦ τ’ (= ἦ τε), a strengthened affirmation: ’truly, surely’ (ἦ τ’ ἂν πολὺ κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would surely have been far better’) · also after a relative of size or amount, with no connective force: ὅσην τ’ ὄρεος κορυφήν ’as large as a mountain’s peak’
τάς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. pl.: ’them’, of the Sirens · also ’them’, of the rocks (accented before the enclitic γε)
τί: τίς, τί — who? what?; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially ’why’ · also the enclitic indefinite τις, τι ’someone, something’ (accented τί before an enclitic): neut. acc. sg. used adverbially with a negative, ’at all’ (οὔ τι) · adj. · also plain interrogative, direct object/predicate: ’what’ (τί πάθω ’what am I to suffer’; τί ... γένηται ’what is to become’) · also the enclitic indefinite as an adjective agreeing with a noun, accented before enclitic που: εἴ τί που εἴλυμα ’if any wrapper’ · also enclitic indefinite with a negative, ’anything’, as accusative subject of an infinitive (οὐ … τί φημι κακώτερον ἄλλο … συγχεῦαι ’I say nothing else is worse’) · also enclitic indefinite, adverbial without a negative: ’somehow, in some way’ (τοῦτό τί μοι κάλλιστον ’this seems to me somehow the fairest’) · also enclitic indefinite as an adjective after μή, accented before an enclitic: ’any’ (μή τί τοι … πῆμα ’any harm to you’)
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τειρεσίαο: Τειρεσίας — Tiresias, the Theban seer; masc. gen. sg., epic -αο (= Attic -ου)
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — tool, gear, armor, equipment; neut. nom./acc. pl.
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τούτου: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. sg.
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’) · also demonstrative with a noun: masc. acc. pl. ’those, the’ (τοὺς ἄλλους … ἑταίρους ’the rest of my companions’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: masc./neut. dat. pl. ’in which, with which’ (τετυγμένα, τοῖς ἐνάμελγεν ’well-made, in which he milked’)
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’from/to them’
τόδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., neut. nom./acc. sg.
τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., acc. sg. (agreeing with ἄεθλον)
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg. ’her’ · also ’it’, of a thing (τὴν = the clothing): fem. acc. sg. · also with a noun, article-like: τὴν ὁδόν ’that journey’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom; fem. acc. sg. (τὴν Ὠκεανὸς τέκε ’whom Oceanus begot’) · also ’the other’, contrasted with a preceding τὴν … μέν: fem. acc. sg. (τὴν δέ ’the other one’)
τῶν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); gen. pl. ’of these things, of them’ · also with a noun, article-like: τῶν ἄλλων ἀνέμων ’of the other winds’ · also distributive, ’of the one … of the other’ (τῶν μὲν … τῶν δ’ ’of the one band … of the other’)
τῶνδε: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc./neut. gen. pl.
φάνεσκε: φαίνω — show; pass. appear; iterative impf. 3 sg. pass. in -σκε, unaugmented: ’would appear’
φάσαν: φημί — say; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἔφασαν): ’they said’
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg. (same form): φέρε χηλὸν ’bring the chest’
φίλοι: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. nom. pl.: ’dear (guest-friends)’ · also masc. voc. pl. (identical form), direct address: ’friends!’ (δεῦτε, φίλοι) · also attributive, with a noun: φίλοι υἷες ’dear sons’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
φθέγγοντο: φθέγγομαι — utter a sound, call out; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφθέγγοντο)
φύγομεν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. 1 pl., unaugmented (= ἐφύγομεν): ’we escaped’
χάρυβδιν: Χάρυβδις — Charybdis, the whirlpool monster; fem. acc. sg.
χάρυβδις: Χάρυβδις — Charybdis, the whirlpool monster; fem. nom. sg.
χειρῶν: χείρ — hand; gen. pl., genitive of separation: ’from their hands’
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
χλωρὸν: χλωρός — green, fresh (of living wood); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also of honey, neut. acc. sg.: ’yellow, pale’ (μέλι χλωρόν ’yellow honey’) · also of fear, neut. nom. sg.: ’pale’ (χλωρὸν δέος ’pale fear’)
ἀλεγεινῆς: ἀλεγεινός — painful, grievous; fem. gen. sg.
ἀλεύασθαι: ἀλέομαι — avoid, shun; aor. inf. mid., epic ἀλεύομαι stem
ἀλύξαι: ἀλύσκω — flee, escape, avoid; aor. inf. act., epexegetic: ’to escape’ (of Proteus straining to get away)
ἀμφοτέροισιν: ἀμφότερος — both; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ ... βάλλομεν = ἀμφιβάλλομεν ’we threw around, embraced’)
ἀμύμονα: ἀμύμων — blameless, excellent (traditional sense; exact meaning uncertain); adj., fem. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg.: ἀμύμονα Λαοδάμαντα ’blameless Laodamas’
ἀνστάντες: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic apocope (ἀνστάντες = ἀναστάντες)
ἀνώγει: ἄνωγα (defective, perf. with pres. force) — command, bid, order; impf. 3 sg., + inf.: ’was bidding’ · also pres. 3 sg., a present formed on the perf. stem: ’bids’ (ἐποτρύνει καὶ ἀνώγει ’urges and bids’)
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρετῇ: ἀρετή — excellence, virtue, prowess; fem. dat. sg., dat. of respect: ’in excellence’
ἀσπαίροντα: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; pres. part. masc. acc. sg.
ἀχνύμενοι: ἄχνυμαι — be grieved, sorrow; pres. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.
ἀχνύμενος: ἄχνυμαι — grieve, be vexed, be distressed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.
ἁλμυρὸν: ἁλμυρός — briny, salty; adj., neut. acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
ἁλὸς: ἅλς — sea, salt water; fem. gen. sg. · also masc. gen. sg., with the masc. adjective πολιοῖο: ’of the grey sea’ (ἁλὸς πολιοῖο)
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἄγεθ: ἄγετε (elided ἄγεθ’) — come now! (interjectional imperative of ἄγω); 2 pl.
ἄκουσα: ἀκούω — hear; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἤκουσα)
ἄμμε: ἐγώ — I; acc. pl. ’us’, Aeolic-epic (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἄμμιν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; epic dat. pl. ἄμμι(ν) (= Attic ἡμῖν)
ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἅμα: ἅμα — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐδέγμην: δέχομαι — receive, await, expect; aor. (root form) 1 sg. mid., epic: ’I was expecting’
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐκέλευον: κελεύω — urge, exhort, bid; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented · also impf. 1 sg., augmented: ’I urged’
ἐμέ: ἐγώ — I; acc. sg., accented emphatic form (non-enclitic) (= enclitic με): ’me’
ἐμοὶ: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg.: ’to, for me’
ἐμοῖς: ἐμός — my, mine; masc. dat. pl.
ἐμυθεόμην: μυθέομαι — tell, relate, speak; impf. 1 sg. mid., iterative sense: ’I used to tell’
ἐμὸν: ἐμός — my, mine; masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’my’ (ὄνομ’ … ἐμὸν ’my name’; ἐμὸν κῆρ ’my heart’)
ἐμῇ: ἐμός — my, mine; fem. dat. sg.
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνόησα: νοέω — perceive, catch sight of, notice; aor. 1 sg., augmented
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’) · also + dat., of time: ’in, within’ (ἐπ’ ἤματι ’in a day’)
ἐπέεσσι: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπιμαίεο: ἐπιμαίομαι — strive for, seek after; pres. imper. 2 sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἐπιμαίου), + gen.
ἐπιτέλλομαι: ἐπιτέλλω — enjoin, charge, command (+ dat.); pres. 1 sg. mid.: ’I enjoin’
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’) · also adverb of sequence, ’next, thereupon’ (ἦλθε δ’ ἐπὶ ψυχή ’and next came the soul’) · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: ἐπὶ … τέταλτο = ἐπιτέταλτο ’was laid upon, entrusted’
ἐρίηρες: ἐρίηρος — trusty, dear (of companions; exact sense uncertain); masc. nom. pl.
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἑλὼν: αἱρέω — take, seize, grasp; aor. act. part. masc. nom. sg. (ἑλών): ’having seized’
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑτάροισιν: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ἑτέρωθι: ἑτέρωθι — elsewhere, in another place; adv.
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl.
ἔβαινον: βαίνω — go, step; impf. 3 pl. (or 1 sg.), augmented; in tmesis with ἀνά (ἀνά … ἔβαινον = ἀνέβαινον ’they mounted’)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔμπεσε: ἐμπίπτω — fall into, fall upon (+ dat.); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’fell into’
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔνθεν: ἔνθεν — from there, thence; adv. of place, with suffix -θεν · also ’on the one side’ (ἔνθεν μὲν γὰρ πέτραι ’on one side are rocks’)
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔπτατ: πέτομαι — fly; aor. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἔπτατ’ = ἔπτατο; Attic ἐπτάμην)
ἔρεσσον: ἐρέσσω — row; impf. 3 pl.: ’were rowing’ · also impf. 1 sg.: ’I was rowing’ (ζωὸς ἔρεσσον ’I rowed when alive’)
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔσχετο: ὑπισχνέομαι (aor. mid. of ἔχω; in tmesis ὑπὸ ... ἔσχετο = ὑπέσχετο) — promise; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’promised’ · also ἔχω (ἴσχω) — hold, check; aor. mid. 3 sg.: ’was checked’ (θαλερὴ ἔσχετο φωνή)
ἔτ: ἔτι — still, yet; adv., elided (ἔτ’ = ἔτι)
ἕκαστον: ἕκαστος — each, every; masc. acc. sg.
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἠελίοιο: Ἠέλιος — the Sun (god); gen. sg., epic (-οιο = Attic Ἡλίου)
ἠεροειδέα: ἠεροειδής — misty-looking, dark like mist; masc. acc. sg.
ἠμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid.: ’answered’
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤθελ: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; impf. 3 sg., elided (ἤθελ’ = ἤθελε): ’he wished’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’) · also ’or’, the second alternative of a pair of questions with no preceding ἠέ: ζώει … ἦ τέθνηκε ’alive or dead’; ἢ ἔτ’ ἔχει … ἦ μιν ἀτιμάζουσιν ’whether … or’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱκόμεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 pl., unaugmented, elided (ἱκόμεθ’ = ἱκόμεθα): ’we have come’
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον) · also aor. 3 pl. (the same ending serves both persons): ’they saw’
ἴκρια: ἴκρια — deck-planks, decking (of a ship or raft); neut. acc. pl.
ἴφια: ἴφιος — stout, sturdy (the traditional gloss; ’fat’ also given); neut. acc. pl., with μῆλα
ὀίω: ὀΐω — suppose, think (short-form by-word of ὀΐομαι); pres. 1 sg.
ὀφθαλμοῖσι: ὀφθαλμός — eye; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οῖς)
ὀφρύσι: ὀφρύς — eyebrow, brow; fem. dat. pl., epic -υσι (= Attic -ύσι)
ὄλεθρον: ὄλεθρος — destruction, ruin, death; acc. sg.
ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
ὄσσε: ὄσσε — the two eyes; neut. dual noun, no sg., epic (= Attic ὄμματα)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as much as’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb: ὅσσ’ ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἑρπετὰ γίγνονται ’as many creatures as come to be upon earth’
ὅτ: ὅτε (elided ὅτ’) — when; temporal conj., here + ἄν and subj. in a general/future clause · also + indic., of a single definite past event: ’when’ (ὅτ’ ἐν Ἄργεϊ ... ἵστασαν ’when they were mooring in Argos’) · also + opt., in a repeated past clause: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂψ ἄρχοιτο ’whenever he began again’) · also + subj. without ἄν, in a general clause: ὅτ’ … ἔχῃ ’whenever … holds’ · also in ὡς ὅτ’, ’as when (a minstrel does)’, the verb left unexpressed
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’) · also with the optative, iterative in past time: ’whenever’ (ὅτε μέλλοι ’whenever he was about to’) · also with the pres. indic., ’whereas, when’ (ὅτε τ’ ἄλλοι ἅπαξ θνῄσκουσ’ ἄνθρωποι ’whereas other men die only once’)
ὑμῖν: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; dat. pl.: ’to you’
ὑπένερθε: ὑπένερθε(ν) — below, underneath, beneath; adv., + gen.: ’below’ (ὑπένερθε Χίοιο ’below Chios’)
ὑπερίονος: Ὑπερίων — Hyperion, a name of the Sun-god; gen. sg.
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὕπερθεν: ὕπερθεν — above, from above, on top; adv.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’) · also ὡς + ἄν + opt., potential, ’as, in the way that, such as’ (ὡς οὐκ ἂν ἔλποιο ’such as you would not expect’) · also introducing a simile with the subj. and no ἄν: ’as when (a woman weeps)’ · also in an asseveration with fut. indic., ’as surely as’ (ὡς οὐκ ὀφθαλμόν γ’ ἰήσεται ’as surely as nothing will heal the eye’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. with a finite verb: ’how (dear) he is’ (ὡς ὅδε … φίλος … ἐστίν)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤτρυνον: ὀτρύνω — urge on, spur, exhort; impf. 3 pl., augmented: ’they urged on’ · also impf. 1 sg.: ’I urged on’
ὦκα: ὦκα — quickly, swiftly; adv., from ὠκύς
ὧδ: ὧδε — so, thus, in this way; adv., elided (ὧδ’ = ὧδε)
ᾕρει: αἱρέω — take, seize; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’seized’
ῥάβδῳ: ῥάβδος — rod, wand; fem. dat. sg., instrumental
ῥόον: ῥόος — current, stream, flow; masc. acc. sg.
